q1_what_did_you_play: Rapid Fire on Nibbit for 0, consuming 3 Sparks, then Kaboom! on Nibbit for its printed cost of 1, then Duck and Cover for 1.
q2_other_line_considered: Kaboom! first for 0, consuming the Sparks, followed by Rapid Fire for its printed cost of 2. It dealt the same total damage but gained no Block.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up nothing in damage versus the other line; it retained 5 Block against Nibbit's telegraphed 12-damage attack.
q4_different_intent: No. With only one enemy, this line deals the maximum available attack damage while also adding 5 Block, so a different telegraphed intent would not have changed it.
